Bulls and Cows

Bulls and Cows — guess the secret 4-digit number from A (bulls) and B (cows) feedback.

0
Guesses
—
Best (fewest)

A = bulls (right digit, right spot) · B = cows (right digit, wrong spot). The secret never repeats a digit.

📖 How to use

  1. Press “New game” to get a secret 4-digit number.
  2. Type your guess (4 different digits) and press “Guess”.
  3. Read the A/B feedback: A = right digit, right spot; B = right digit, wrong spot.
  4. Get 4A0B to win — fewest guesses wins.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do A and B mean?

A means bulls: right digit in the right place. B means cows: right digit but in the wrong place. So “1A2B” = one digit perfectly placed, two more correct digits misplaced.

Can digits repeat?

Yes — every game uses 4 different digits, and the number never starts with 0.

Any strategy tips?

Start with 4 distinct digits (e.g. 1234) to maximize information, then use the A/B counts to eliminate. With perfect play it takes about 5–6 tries on average.
